intro: Camping 101: Fishing introduces novice anglers in Elwynn Forest to the practical craft of wilderness survival and camp amenities. By seeking out local fishing expert Lee Brown near Goldshire, travelers can learn to apply their angling knowledge toward crafting cozy additions for a campsite, such as a decorative fish bowl that bolsters adventurers' spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
